name: Edward Takasaki
source:
The school nurse, and also a counselor.

Friendly and easy to talk to, he's regarded as something of an older brother figure. The students call him "Ed-sensei". Since he has a good and open nature regardless of who he's talking to, Edward often finds himself a confidant of many students. Especially soft on female students, he looks out for the newcomer Neri. Edward is half-Chariot, half-Japanese.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/04/28/zettai-kaikyuu-gakuen-eden-with-roses-and-phantasm/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
